All seven gaps have a document whose content settles them. I found no defect in the behaviours. I read the three new specs, the hand-off and the triage note in full. I read one of the two decision records, `a-quick-lane-run-takes-no-review.adr.md`, in full. The other, `review-independence-is-held-by-inputs-and-the-session-record.adr.md`, I did not open. Its role for G1 and G6 rests on the hand-off and on the specs that cite it. For `overview.spec.md` and `code-join.spec.md` I saw only the lines a search for "review" printed, plus the line numbers it gave. The G7 grade therefore rests on those lines alone.

The gate's check findings for criteria 1–7, 10–13, 16 and 17 are taken as given.

Two further points:
- **Scenario fixtures (criterion 14):** the scenarios in `review-findings.spec.md` use illustrative values such as `src/a.py:42`. They are not copied from the task, so no fixture is carried in.
- **Open questions:** the five open questions each carry an `Until answered` default and do not block planning.
